full_prompt_en: A square black and white pictorial photograph shows a young woman standing in profile inside a dim room, looking upward toward a bright window dense with leaves. She occupies the lower left center of the image, wearing a pale long sleeved blouse with gathered cuffs and a softly draped front. Her dark hair is neatly coiled at the nape. Her lifted face catches the edge of the window light, outlining her nose, lips, cheek, and brow while the rest of her head remains in gentle gray shadow. The window rises on the right behind hanging foliage; stems and leaves overlap the luminous panes and fall across the upper center of the frame. Beneath it, a mass of indistinct potted plants creates a dark, textured lower right. At the left rear, picture frames or panels hang in deep shadow, barely separating from the wall. The woman appears still, with arms relaxed near her waist, and the foliage seems to surround the space between her and the outdoors. Light enters through the leaves from the upper right and scatters into pale halos, while most corners remain velvety black. Focus is soft at the edge but her profile remains readable, with fine grain and slightly uneven exposure lending the image an aged photographic surface. The scene is hushed and introspective, built from a luminous vertical opening, dark botanical silhouettes, and one poised figure in the half light.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白画意摄影作品描绘一名年轻女子侧身站在昏暗房间里，抬头看向枝叶繁密的明亮窗户。她位于下方偏左中部，穿浅色长袖上衣，袖口收拢，衣襟柔软垂落。深发整齐盘在颈后。扬起的脸接住窗边缘光，鼻子、双唇、面颊与眉骨得到勾勒，头部其余部分留在柔和灰影中。窗户从右侧升起，悬垂枝叶遮住发亮窗格，茎叶重叠并落向画面上方中央。窗下，一团模糊盆栽形成深暗而有纹理的右下角。左后方，画框或墙板挂在深影里，几乎与墙面难分。女子静静站立，双臂放松在腰际附近，枝叶仿佛围住她与室外之间的空间。光从右上穿过叶片进入，散成浅色光晕，多数角落仍是天鹅绒般黑色。边缘焦点柔软，但她的侧脸仍可辨；细颗粒和稍不均的曝光给影像陈旧摄影表面。场景静谧而内省，由明亮竖向开口、深色植物剪影和一位站在半明半暗处的人物构成。
style_prompt_en: Black and white pictorial photography uses a broad shadow range, luminous windowlike openings, and gentle focus to build a contemplative atmosphere. Deep charcoal and near black masses enclose a smaller glowing area, while irregular translucent shapes break the light into layered silhouettes. Edge light skims one central contour and turns selected surfaces to pale silver, leaving adjacent planes in soft gray. Fine film grain, slight halation, and subtly uneven exposure give the image an aged print quality. Details are richest around the transition from light to dark, then dissolve toward the corners. Vertical structure and descending organic marks balance the composition without rigid symmetry. Contrast is strong across the whole frame but gradual within each form, so the darkness feels velvety rather than flat. The overall effect is intimate, atmospheric, and still, with a quiet exchange between bright exterior light and sheltered interior shadow.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白画意摄影利用宽广暗部、发亮的窗状开口和柔和焦点建立沉思气氛。深炭灰与近黑体块围住较小的发光区域，不规则半透明形状把光切成层叠剪影。轮廓光掠过中央一道边缘，让选定表面变成浅银色，相邻平面则保持柔灰。细胶片颗粒、轻微光晕和略不均的曝光带来陈旧相纸质感。细节在明暗交界最丰富，随后向角落消散。竖向结构与下垂的有机痕迹平衡构图，却不形成僵硬对称。全画面对比强烈，但各形体内部渐变温和，使黑暗像天鹅绒而非平涂。整体亲密、有空气感且静止，明亮外部光与受到庇护的内部阴影安静交流。
theme_en: A woman looking toward daylight through a foliage filled window
theme_zh: 女子透过枝叶繁茂的窗户望向日光
name: Arnold Genthe
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
